chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Greatness of the Creator appreciated by you would belittle the creatures in your view.
ai.seo_question: How does recognizing God's greatness affect one's view of creation?
ai.summary: In this maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates a core principle of spiritual perception: the magnitude of one's awareness of Allah (Al-Kabir) directly inversely correlates with the perceived status of creation. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that true reverence (ta'zim) for the Divine naturally leads to humility (tawadu') towards creatures, preventing arrogance and ego-inflation.
